summary: A receipt for placing one build into a mod manager or the game folder: where, which files with their hashes, and the mod list before.

target.doc: Where it went: MO2 (instance, profile, separator) or the game folder.

files.doc: Each file placed, with its hash.

previousModlist.doc: The mod list as it was before, for restoring.

replaced.doc: The earlier install of the same mod this one replaced.

migration.how: Each receipt becomes an install node referencing the build of the mod node with the same UUID.

x-friction.gap: Copying into a mod manager isn't repeatable; a crash mid-copy must resume from the recorded outcome.
x-friction.closes: An outside effect with an idempotency key and a recorded outcome.
